pages.title: Ritual Brazier
pages.text: Ritual Braziers hold the ingredients used by Nature's Ritual. To create one, crouch and right-click any plank block with an $(l:hexalia:content/tools#athame)Athame$(/l).

pages.title: Preparation
pages.text: For $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/natures_ritual)Nature's Ritual$(/l), place an offering in each needed brazier, then add Salt. Braziers may stand anywhere on the Ritual Table's level within 8 blocks; no fixed pattern is required. Only the braziers matched to a ritual are consumed.
